prompt:
Use aged paper, restrained sepia color, halftone print texture, and archival cutout framing.
Treat photographs and documents as tactile evidence layers with legible hierarchy.
Avoid: Glossy modern gradients, neon color, and playful preschool proportions.
Composition: Organize evidence in measured overlapping planes with one dominant archival focal point.
Composition: Preserve readable margins, captions, and document edges instead of filling every gap.
Create one exquisite full-frame cinematic paper-collage environment. Exact landscape 1672x941, no panels or contact sheet. Aged ivory cotton paper, muted indigo photographic printing, restrained amber, sepia halftone, tactile torn edges and shallow paper shadows, realistic elegant proportions. An empty small seaside railway platform at blue hour after rain. Oblique cinematic view along the platform, vanishing point at 68 percent width and 40 percent height. A delicate weathered iron canopy on the left, one elegant dark wooden bench at left middle, wet paving and long warm amber reflections, slender lamp posts receding toward misty hills on the right, a suggestion of railway tracks. Indigo blue grey rain clouds against cream paper. Beautiful quiet melancholy, a place where someone once waited. The entire lower 18 percent gently dissolves into ivory rag paper for lyrics; architecture remains fully visible above. No trains, no people, no signs, no clock numbers, no text. Gallery quality, richly detailed but spacious. No text, logos or watermarks. Opaque background. The architectural perspective must be coherent.
